Friday Mahomes(knee/right elbow), Rice(knee), Kelce(ankle), Worthy(hamstring) full with no game designation. Jaylon Moore OUT. Kenneth Walker newly groin DNP/questionable. These facts do not resolve passing allocation or effectiveness.

Friday Dell FP with no designation; Harrison OUT. Marks FP/no designation, Montgomery FP/questionable. Houston Hunter OUT, Anderson DNP/questionable, Al-Shaair OUT challenge the cheaper Texans DST alternative. Opposing Boston LP/questionable; Fannin/Jenkins FP/no designation.
Friday CMC full/no designation. Generic table lists Trent Williams NIR-rest; dated Friday article instead identifies new shoulder injury, so article governs that injury explanation.

Nov13 dated article: CMC full Thu/Fri with no designation; Deebo full/no designation, Evans OUT; Allen completed three practices and coach says he will have a role. Trent Williams questionable after shoulder injury Thursday and Friday DNP. No automatic target allocation inferred.
Friday Alie-Cox and tackle Jalen Travis OUT, Mallory LP/questionable. Warren not listed: no reported designation found, not a complete medical certification or guaranteed route expansion.
Current BUF@NYJ Friday table has no James Cook row. Absence from injury table and blank CSV status do not prove Sunday active; no new reported Cook limitation found.
Boston LP/questionable corroborated by Cleveland; Concepcion not listed, Jenkins FP/no designation. Boston may play; no presumed vacated-target windfall.

Current Friday table: Garrett knee/NIR-rest DNP/questionable; McDuffie back and Curl toe LP/questionable. This resolves the missing Thursday/Friday coverage, not final availability. Garrett mixed injury/rest wording does not by itself prove deterioration. Rams Avila/Ferguson OUT; Higbee illness LP/no designation, Parkinson FP/no designation, Allen LP/questionable.

Current Arizona report independently corroborates Rams final designations. Froholdt concussion and Gaines ankle OUT, Jayden Williams knee questionable. Opponent protection losses counterbalance Rams availability risk; no sack/turnover forecast.

interpretation: Hold nine: selected offensive availability supports participation, not point/route guarantees.
Rams three questionable defenders weaken the front case; Arizona Froholdt/Gaines OUT provide contrary protection evidence. No healthy-unit certification.
Houston model edge is only0.8 and Hunter/Anderson/Al-Shaair losses matter; no purely numerical switch.
Boston returning LP challenges vacancy reasoning. Keep Concepcion on participation/value without assuming Boston inactive.
Dated SF article supersedes generic Williams rest label for shoulder injury; retain source conflict.
Provider update clock advanced but selected rounded estimates stayed147.0; old projections remain untouched.

alternatives.reason: Model edge0.8, but Hunter OUT, Anderson questionable and Al-Shaair OUT weaken Houston. Also adds DST against selected CLE receiver and a third HOU@CLE selection.
Reduces KC exposure to12,100. Ferguson OUT helps, but Parkinson full/no designation and Davis Allen questionable preserve competition; Higbee illness LP. No verified route advantage.
Improved LP but still questionable. No role evidence outweighs Concepcion and the lower coherent model estimate; perfect spend is unnecessary.

uncertainty: Rams three questionable defenders and Sunday participation; their inactives may arrive after the experiment cutoff.
KC $16,800 passing concentration, Moore OUT protection and Downs/Worthy/Rice/Kelce allocation.
Dell rotation and ESPN9/PFF8 target coverage conflict; Harrison OUT does not quantify route gain.
Boston may play; Concepcion receiving share with Watson remains uncertain.
Warren absolute opportunity/protection and Cook receiving floor; no designation is not a workload guarantee.
change_triggers: Material Sunday activation/limitation before freeze; bind exact nine and retained expectations BEFORE Nov15 17:30UTC.
Credible loss of Garrett/more Rams coverage prompts DST reassessment with full budget and opponent protection evidence; do not wait past cutoff for late inactives.
Retain any actual Claude response and exact dispositions; no original restart or routine new Grok pass.

carry_forward: Sunday final must bind exact nine, original salaries and applicable retained expectation IDs before17:30UTC; daily is not freeze.
Late-game inactives may be unknown at cutoff; late news becomes an experiment outcome.
Differentiate full practice/no designation, active status, routes and effectiveness.

Reuse existing Claude request; preserve actual exchange and unanswered latest delta. Grok original pass complete; no routine repeat.
